artboards.title: Today — the wall connector is added, and shown nowhere
A — a card for it, in the garage
B — say so when it is added
C — a line in the band, only while it charges

annotations.text:
WHY THIS EXISTS

A Tesla Wall Connector was found nearby, set up, and said Added -- and then appeared nowhere: not in a room, not under New devices, not on Home. Accounts listed it with one button, Remove (7 October 2026).

Nothing broke. Its nineteen readings are all diagnostics, and the panel draws what a household controls plus a room's temperature, humidity, light and motion; power and energy were left for an energy view that was never drawn. So the question is what a car charger is in this house, and it is a question about the screen, so it is drawn first.

TODAY

The garage as the panel draws it with the charger added: the rooms it already had, and nothing for the charger. The note stands where its card would be.

A -- A CARD FOR IT

The charger is a thing in the garage like the door and the freezer, and says what it is doing in three words: Charging, Plugged in, Ready. Power shows while it charges. Nothing to tap, because the car decides when it charges; holding opens what it read.

For: a household checking whether the car is plugged in has somewhere to look. Against: a new kind of card, the first one with nothing to control.

B -- SAY SO

No card: the last step of adding says what is true, in plain words, and where it is listed. The same rule covers anything else that arrives with only readings.

For: the smallest change, and it stops a success that leads nowhere. Against: the household learns the hub cannot show the thing it just bought, and that is all.

C -- A LINE IN THE BAND

While the car charges, the garage's band says so, and so does Home's, where the house already says a door is open. When it stops, the line goes at a moment nobody is watching.

For: news when there is news, and nothing otherwise. Against: a charger with no car, or a full car, says nothing, so there is nowhere to check whether the car is plugged in.

DECIDED 8 OCTOBER 2026 -- A, WITH C'S LINE

A card in the garage that says Charging, Plugged in or Ready, with the power while it charges and nothing to tap; and while the car charges, a line in Home's band: The car is charging, with the power and the room.

Home's band only, as built: in the garage the card and the room's own line (Charging the car) already say it, and the band does not repeat a card on the same screen (app/src/printers.ts, bandNotes). When the car stops, the line stays until nobody is looking, like everything else in the band.

B stays the floor for anything else that arrives with only readings: an add that succeeds and leads nowhere should never say only Added.
